title: Frontend: OTP Input Component
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind OTP Input Component. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Use one labelled Code input with numeric inputMode and one-time-code autocomplete, with six visual slots[data-slot=0..5]. Strip non-ASCII digits and clamp to six. Empty slots display •. Output [data-testid=complete] yes exactly for six digits. Clear resets. This component formats a code; server verification is excluded.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Decide whether to use one semantic input with visual slots or multiple coordinated inputs.
alternativeApproaches: Add an expiry/resend flow that does not let an old code submission overwrite a newer challenge state.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Full paste; partial paste; Backspace on empty slot.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
